title: SynScan simulator discovery can initialize a physical network mount
summary: The existing simulator autodetection case broadcasts to 255.255.255.255 and connects before checking that DEVICE_PORT is local. A physical mount can answer before the fixture (which drops five replies), receive connection/initialization commands, and the test then skips as a pass. Constrain discovery to loopback in the test build, retain real UDP parsing/retries and fail a nonlocal responder; verify before closure. Production hardware discovery must remain unchanged.
evidence: verification.md: simulator-only discovery boundary; test source previously documented that physical mounts could win discovery before its local check.

resolution.evidence: Task verification.md: test-only loopback discovery substitution, nonlocal assertion, passing confined discovery with real UDP retries in normal and ASan/UBSan builds. Production discovery unchanged.
